[[Axe of the Firstwatch]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. As the name would suggest, this axe is a replica of the one [[Firstwatch Sergio]] wields.

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while Health is above 50%)
:Double [[adrenaline]] gain (Chance: 10%)
:[[Armor]] +5 

==Skin==
Uses the same skin as a [[Gemstone Axe]], [[dye]]d red.
